items.title: Show HN: Persistent Mind Model – AI that develops its own identity
items.raw_excerpt:
Hi HN! I’ve been building something called the Persistent Mind Model (PMM). It started as a side project on my home rig (i7-10700K / RTX 3080 / 32 GB RAM) because I was frustrated that every local AI chat starts from zero.
I wanted a system that could remember its own development and be studied like a living mind. So I decided to try building one. I mean, why not? :) Basically, if I could describe the Persistent Mind Model, I would describe it as an event-sourced cognitive architecture for language models. It’s model-agnostic, meaning you can use local models through Ollama or connect to OpenAI’s API, and the system keeps the same “identity” regardless of backend. Everything it says or decides, reflections, commitments, personality drifts, is stored as hash-chained events in a local SQLite

excerpt_i18n.en:
On October 24, Tencent released the 2025 Tencent R&D Big Data Report, systematically disclosing its R&D progress for the first time. The report shows that AI has been fully integrated into Tencent's R&D system, becoming a new engine driving efficiency improvements. Over 90% of Tencent engineers use the AI programming assistant CodeBuddy, and 50% of new code is AI-assisted. By leveraging WeDev to streamline the R&D toolchain and connect processes, overall R&D efficiency has increased by over 20%.

In 2025, R&D personnel made up 76% of Tencent's workforce, meaning three out of every four employees were engaged in R&D. Tencent added an average of 325 million lines of code monthly, completed 370,000 requirements, and executed 25.2 million builds and deliveries to support rapid business iteration.

With the support of its self-developed Hunyuan large model, AI has deeply penetrated coding, review, testing, and other stages. Half of all new code is AI-assisted, equivalent to one of every two lines written by engineers receiving AI help. AI assistance has reduced average coding time by 40% and boosted overall R&D efficiency by over 20%.

In code reviews, AI participation reached 94%, meaning nearly every code submission is pre-reviewed by an AI quality inspector before human engineers intervene. AI identified 28% of code defects.

El informe muestra que la IA se ha integrado completamente en el sistema de I+D de Tencent, convirtiéndose en un "nuevo motor" que impulsa la eficiencia en el desarrollo. Más del 90% de los ingenieros de Tencent utilizan el asistente de programación con IA CodeBuddy para apoyar su trabajo, y el 50% del código nuevo se genera con asistencia de IA. Gracias a WeDev, se ha optimizado la cadena de herramientas de eficiencia en I+D, integrando los procesos de desarrollo y logrando una mejora superior al 20% en la eficiencia general de I+D de la empresa. En 2025, el 76% del personal de Tencent se dedica a la investigación y desarrollo, es decir, 3 de cada 4 empleados.

IMA 2.0 includes features such as the "Task Mode" based on agent capabilities and the knowledge base "AI Key Points." The upgraded IMA will become a "collaborative partner" capable of understanding goals, executing tasks, and producing results.

Through intelligent agents enabling autonomous planning, the "Task Mode" supports generating reports and podcasts. Users can initiate tasks using natural language queries on the homepage or within the knowledge base and attach resources like knowledge bases, documents, images, audio, web pages, and notes, providing the large model with "reference materials" during task execution.
